cases.purpose: Verify independently ordered kernel requests, continuation after errors, aggregate status and actual activation of both valid swapfiles.
cases.oracle: Fixed operand sequence and Linux errno controls, with seccomp notification and /proc/swaps observations.
cases.comparison: Candidate status 1, exact four ordered syscall paths and zero flags, path-specific EINVAL and ENOENT diagnostics, and only the two valid files active; setup and cleanup must succeed.
cases.script:
set -u
export LC_ALL=C PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
RT=/tmp/rt-swapon-multiple
M=$RT/mnt
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-seccomp.py
cleanup() {
  /usr/sbin/swapoff "$M/s1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
  /usr/sbin/swapoff "$M/s2" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
  /usr/bin/umount "$M" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
}
trap cleanup EXIT
fail() { echo "FAIL: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(/usr/bin/wc -l < /proc/swaps)" -eq 1 ] || fail 'guest must start without active swaps'
/usr/bin/mkdir -p "$M" || fail mkdir
/usr/bin/truncate -s 8M "$RT/sw.img" || fail image
/usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal "$RT/sw.img" || fail mkfs
/usr/bin/mount -o loop "$RT/sw.img" "$M" || fail mount
for name in nonswap s1 s2; do
  /usr/bin/dd if=/dev/zero of="$M/$name" bs=64k count=16 status=none || fail create
  /usr/bin/chmod 0600 "$M/$name" || fail chmod
done
/usr/sbin/mkswap -q "$M/s1" >/dev/null || fail mkswap1
/usr/sbin/mkswap -q "$M/s2" >/dev/null || fail mkswap2
# Prove the guest can activate this exact filesystem and that both failing
# operands produce the expected kernel errno before measuring the candidate.
/usr/sbin/swapon "$M/s1" || fail 'activation prerequisite'
/usr/sbin/swapoff "$M/s1" || fail 'deactivation prerequisite'
/usr/bin/python3 - "$M/nonswap" "$M/missing" <<'CONTROL' || fail 'kernel error prerequisites'
import ctypes, errno, sys
lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
lib.swapon.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int]
for path, expected in zip(sys.argv[1:], (errno.EINVAL, errno.ENOENT)):
    ctypes.set_errno(0)
    result = lib.swapon(path.encode(), 0)
    if result != -1 or ctypes.get_errno() != expected:
        raise SystemExit('unexpected control errno for ' + path + ': ' + str(ctypes.get_errno()))
CONTROL
: > "$RT/requests.jsonl"
/usr/bin/chmod 0666 "$RT/requests.jsonl"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" --notify swapon --reply swapon=continue --log-string swapon=0 --log-args swapon=1 --log "$RT/requests.jsonl" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '[[ $(type -t swapon) == builtin ]] || exit 97; swapon "$@"' _ "$M/nonswap" "$M/s1" "$M/missing" "$M/s2" >"$RT/out" 2>"$RT/err"
status=$?
[ "$status" -eq 1 ] || fail "candidate status $status"
/usr/bin/python3 - "$RT" "$M" <<'CHECK' || fail 'observations differ from contract'
import json, pathlib, sys
rt, mount = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
requests = [json.loads(line) for line in (rt / 'requests.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
expected = [str(mount / name) for name in ('nonswap', 's1', 'missing', 's2')]
assert [(r['syscall'], r.get('string0'), r.get('arg1')) for r in requests] == [('swapon', name, 0) for name in expected], requests
assert (rt / 'out').read_bytes() == b''
err = (rt / 'err').read_text()
assert expected[0] in err and 'Invalid argument' in err, err
assert expected[2] in err and 'No such file or directory' in err, err
rows = pathlib.Path('/proc/swaps').read_text().splitlines()[1:]
assert len(rows) == 2 and {row.split()[0] for row in rows} == {expected[1], expected[3]}, rows
CHECK
/usr/sbin/swapoff "$M/s1" || fail swapoff1
/usr/sbin/swapoff "$M/s2" || fail swapoff2
[ "$(/usr/bin/wc -l < /proc/swaps)" -eq 1 ] || fail 'swap table not restored'
/usr/bin/umount "$M" || fail umount
trap - EXIT
printf 'multiple requests verified\n'
